name: sdlc-core
description: Hooks that keep sessions cheap and resumable: a state card at session start, a guard on whole reads of heavy files, a guard that keeps role work out of the main session, trimmed command output, size budgets on boot files, a check of plan/queue.json against its schema, a handoff check for role agents, and a snapshot before compaction. Its commands: next-step, sdlc-budget, sdlc-update to pull the factory's latest rules, and sdlc-metrics. Every hook is off unless the project has .claude/sdlc.json.
